correctness.rationale: For circular w=a^pba^qb and 2m<=n, any Abelian-square halves contain either 0 or 1 marked b each; 0 requires 2m<=max(p,q). One in each half is feasible exactly when shorter circular mark separation min(p,q)+1<=2m−1, and a starting offset max(0,m−min(p,q)−1) witnesses sufficiency. Summing the two disjoint types proves z_m and N with all p,q>=0, including zeros and n=2. At odd n, the permitted intervals cover every half-length, with N=(n−1)/2+(|p−q|−1)/2 and sharp |p−q|=1 equality. Independently enumerated every cyclic factor/half-count for 900 (p,q) pairs 0..29.
